_comment: Shared by prune-target-lists.ts (Apollo) and the Excel exports. minEmployees drops small accounts; customerGroups catch customer brands that buy under a different domain from the customer_accounts record (e.g. Compass USA brands when only Compass UK and Restaurant Associates are recorded). Accounts with no headcount are kept: Apollo returns none for several of the largest FM groups (EMCOR, OCS, Elior UK).
